title: 撤资原因另有说法并存
claim_text: DARPA 2003 年 4 月对 OpenBSD 资助启动复审，并以世界局势与国族威胁为由要求暂停 security fest 部分；题面所称“SELinux 成熟度”解释未获任何可引来源
quote: As a result of the DARPA review of the project, and due to world events and the evolving threat posed by increasingly capable nation-states, the Government [sic] on April 21 advised the University to suspend work on the "security fest" portion of the project.
notes: 同文并置言论说与官方复审说；seclists 转载的 Jan Walker 声明属邮件列表载件（DOC_MINE 非邮件界线）不作证据；SELinux 说两轮检索零命中，检索面见 c1-closed-draft-20261125.tsv

title: GPL 附加限制被拒于 base 之外
claim_text: OpenBSD 拒绝受 GPL 条款约束的新软件进入 base，并把以更自由许可的等价工具替换既有 GPL 组件列为长期目标
quote: As a consequence, no additional software bound by the GPL terms will be considered for inclusion into the OpenBSD base system.
notes: 第二源原句：ISC or Berkeley style licences are preferred, the GPL is not acceptable when adding new code, NDAs are never acceptable.；policy 同页另有 Replacement by equivalent, more freely licensed tools is a long-term desideratum.（替换组件面）

title: 领导期究竟该按什么界标分期？
claim_text: 1995 年 10 月自 NetBSD 分叉、2003 年 4 月 DARPA 撤资、2011 年 11 月 5.0 发行是三个可核界标；但“为何取这三点”属卷内分期选择，外部无依据
quote: OpenBSD came into existence a couple of years later, from a fork of the NetBSD code base in October 1995, with the initial release in July 1996.
notes: 2003 面另有 LWN（reuse:5459，见 1.4.2 行）；2011 面库内 ref2288（50.html）未取文，需主会话核 5.0 发行日；verdict needs_more＝三点源可齐而选点理由不可外证

title: 每代发行对应一次技术路线调整
claim_text: 5.6 将 OpenSSL 分叉为 LibreSSL，目标为代码现代化、安全改进与最佳实践流程
quote: This release forks OpenSSL into LibreSSL, a version of the TLS/crypto stack with goals of modernizing the codebase, improving security, and applying best practice development processes.
notes: 第二源原句：LibreSSL is a version of the TLS/crypto stack forked from OpenSSL in 2014, with goals of modernizing the codebase, improving security, and applying best practice development processes.

title: 每代发行对应一次技术路线调整
claim_text: 5.9 引入 pledge(2)，707 个基础系统二进制中 453 个改用
quote: 453 out of 707 base system binaries were adapted to use pledge.
notes: 第二源 HISTORY：The pledge() system call first appeared in OpenBSD 5.9.

title: 评价尺度不取单一指标
claim_text: 安全审计自 1996 年夏持续进行，构成官方自述的持续性指标
quote: Our security auditing team typically has between six and twelve members who continue to search for and fix new security holes. We have been auditing since the summer of 1996.
notes: 第二源原句：never-ending comprehensive source code audit

title: 评价尺度不取单一指标
claim_text: 发布目标为约每半年一版、五月与十一月为目标日
quote: The OpenBSD team makes a new release approximately every six months, with the target release dates in May and November.
notes: 第二源原句：Make a release approximately every six months.；verdict needs_more＝三项尺度中“代码可读”无锚（未取 style(9)），且尺度取舍属编纂选择

title: 三十年人事连续而技术重心多次断裂
claim_text: 项目自 1995 年起由 Theo de Raadt 在加拿大持续领导，发行页版权行自 1997 年连续署其名
quote: Fortunately for us, the project was always coordinated from Canada by undisputed project leader Theo de Raadt.
notes: 第二源原句：Copyright 1997-2026, Theo de Raadt.；57.html 同句式 Copyright 1997-2015, Theo de Raadt. 可作年代纵贯补证

title: 三十年人事连续而技术重心多次断裂
claim_text: 技术重心多次断裂，如 5.6 分叉 OpenSSL 为 LibreSSL、5.9 集成 pledge(2)
quote: This release forks OpenSSL into LibreSSL, a version of the TLS/crypto stack with goals of modernizing the codebase, improving security, and applying best practice development processes.
notes: 第二源条目：pledge(2) support integrated（5.9 特性清单首条）

title: 评价不评人格只评决策后果
claim_text: 本卷评价只回指可核事件、不评人格；此为编纂自限条款而非史实断言
quote: （无外部引文；属编纂自限条款）
notes: 检索“评价话语自我限制”“不评人格”等零命中；建议主会话按 P5 记 doubts 或移入卷首说明；见 c1-closed-draft-20261125.tsv

title: 5.7 移除加密加速卡与播放器驱动
claim_text: 5.7 移除 lofn 与 nofn（Hifn 加密加速卡）及 art（Accoom T1/E1）驱动
quote: The lofn(4) and nofn(4) drivers for Hifn crypto accelerator devices have been removed.
notes: 第二源仅证设备身份（lofn — Hifn 6500 crypto accelerator），不移除事实；官方 plus57 未列该三条，检索无独立第三方逐条记载，故 verdict single_source

title: 5.7 移除加密加速卡与播放器驱动
claim_text: 5.7 同时移除 urio（Diamond Rio MP3 播放器）驱动
quote: The urio(4) driver for Diamond Multimedia Rio MP3 players has been removed.
notes: 第二源仅证身份（urio — Diamond Multimedia Rio MP3 players）；同前，移除事实单源

title: 5.2 起默认禁用 SSLv2
claim_text: 5.2 在 OpenSSL 中禁用 SSLv2
quote: Disabled SSLv2 in OpenSSL.
notes: 第二源原句：Disabled SSLv2 in the OpenSSL code base.

title: 网络栈为多处理器改造让路
claim_text: 5.6—5.7 网络栈以删除与替换旧组件收缩，ALTQ 移除、路由表取代 RB 树与 IPv4 地址表
quote: ALTQ has been removed.
notes: 第二源原句：The routing table is now used for most of the address lookup operations superseding the RB-tree and IPv4 address list.

title: 网络栈为多处理器改造让路
claim_text: 网络栈改造朝多处理器并行推进，mbuf 层 mpsafe、6.0 网络输入路径入线程上下文
quote: The mbuf(9) layer has been made mpsafe.
notes: 第二源原句：Network input path is now run in thread context.（6.0）

title: 5.9 起 pledge 覆盖基础系统多数程序
claim_text: 5.9 将 pledge(2) 铺开至 707 个基础系统二进制中的 453 个
quote: 453 out of 707 base system binaries were adapted to use pledge.
notes: 题面另含 fork+exec，唯 60.html 记 Implement the fork+exec pattern in smtpd(8).（6.0 而非 5.9，单源），本表不另立 claim；建议改题只留 pledge 面或补 smtpd(8) man 页 HISTORY 后另批

title: 5.5 起 time_t 全平台 64 位
claim_text: 5.5 起 time_t 全平台改为 64 位，2038 年问题在该代解决
quote: time_t is now 64 bits on all platforms.
notes: 第二源原句：OpenBSD 5.5 is year 2038 ready on all platforms, but this required a change to a 64 bit time type, which should cover us for the next 290 billion years.；55.html 另有 will run well beyond Tue Jan 19 03:14:07 2038 UTC

title: 审计团队常年保持六到十二人
claim_text: 安全审计自 1996 年夏持续，官方以“永不停歇的源码审计”自述
quote: We have been auditing since the summer of 1996.
notes: 第二源原句：never-ending comprehensive source code audit

title: 审计团队常年保持六到十二人
claim_text: 审计团队规模通常在六至十二人之间
quote: Our security auditing team typically has between six and twelve members who continue to search for and fix new security holes.
notes: verdict single_source＝规模数字仅官方 security 页一处自述；HN 等引述为同页转抄不计；检索未获独立第二源

title: 源码树权限分读写与只读两级
claim_text: 源码树访问分两级，开发者读写、所有人只读
quote: There are two levels of source tree access: ｜ Read-write access for developers ｜ Read-only access for everyone
notes: 引文按原文三级条目逐段照录（分隔符为全角竖线，非原文）；第二源原句：Provide full source access to developers and users, including the ability to look at CVS tree changes directly

title: 团队规模只能由名单与地图估算
claim_text: 开发者散居各地，官方仅以地图近似其分布且明言不保证更新
quote: Where do our developers live? This map approximates where our developers live. We will attempt to update it occasionally, but please don't count on that.
notes: verdict needs_more＝“规模只能由名单与地图估算”未被任何来源直述；第二源仅证国际性（an international community of developers and end users）；若 thesis 改为“分布只有地图近似”可降 filled_candidate

title: 关键改动逐条署名
claim_text: 创新清单按条目署作者与日期，例：strlcpy 与 strlcat 署 Todd Miller 与 Theo de Raadt，1998 年 7 月 1 日，随 2.4 首发
quote: strlcpy(3), strlcat(3): Todd Miller and Theo de Raadt, July 1, 1998, OpenBSD 2.4
notes: 第二源 AUTHORS 仅署 Todd C. Miller（strlcpy() and strlcat() were created by Todd C. Miller），与清单双署不一致，落块须并置两说；pf 例同页可引但无第二源，未立 claim

title: 聚会仅限受邀者新人只取得观察资格
claim_text: 聚会仅限受邀者，有潜力的新人受邀以观察其能力，且不以培训为目的
quote: Hackathon attendees come by invitation only. Some new people in the community who show promise are sometimes invited to see if they have what it takes. However, hackathons are not developer training events.
notes: 第二源原句：Focus on being developer-oriented in all senses, including holding developer-only events called hackathons.
